# Extract the byte ranges
byte_ranges = []

        unit, rest = range_str.split('=', 1)
        if unit == 'bytes':
            start_end = rest.split('-')
            start = int(start_end[0])
            end = int(start_end[1])
            byte_ranges.append([start, end])

# Output the result
